# Newsletter email: usability audit (2026-09-03)

**Scope:** the sent newsletter email generated by `builder/js/template.js`. Five review lenses (accessibility, email clients, typography/layout, wayfinding/affordance, robustness), every finding then challenged by two skeptics who had to reproduce it in the rendered markup. Contrast ratios and line lengths were measured. 28 findings after de-duplication; Kate's private copy of the full report has the detail per finding.

## Applied (Kate's go, 2026-09-03)

The standing values out of the 18 no-decision fixes:

- **Tail links.** `seeMore(url)` reads `sec.seeMoreUrl` (issue override, `''` =
  no row), else the registry default `POLICY_EXCHANGE_URL` on opportunities,
  policy and headlines. No tail link ships as `href="#"`.
- **Contrast.** See more `#767676` (4.54:1), headline sources `#7A6A6A`
  (5.13:1), dark-mode selectors to match. `rgb(80, 0, 0)` appears only as a
  background, so the dark-mode `td[style*="rgb(80, 0, 0)"]` rule cannot paint
  the date maroon on maroon; the footer cell and lockup set `color:#ffffff` so
  blocked-image alt text stays readable.
- **Preheader.** Hidden after `<body>`: `issue.preheader`, else whole sentences
  of the intro until ≥60 chars, capped at 140.
- **Widths.** A `width` attribute on the masthead `<img>` and on every layout
  table, so classic Outlook's Word engine cannot lay the retina banner out at
  full size. With them: the jump nav carries no label (Kate, 2026-09-08), one
  "Join the mailing list" in header and footer, untitled items skipped with
  their tab and nav entry, blurbs split into paragraphs, `lang="en"`, an XHTML
  doctype, `rel="noopener"`, `aria-hidden` footer icons, `<h2>`/`<h3>` section
  headers and 1.4 line-height on meta lines.

Tests: `builder/tests/template.test.js`, block "Audit fixes (2026-09-03)".

## Kate's call: not applied

- ~~**Phones**~~ — dropped (Kate: desktop only — Outlook Web, Gmail, Apple Mail).
- (was) **Phones:** the fixed 705px sheet shrinks to ~53% on a 375px phone (14px body ≈ 7.4px). Fix = hybrid fluid width (`width="705"` attribute + `style="width:100%; max-width:705px"` and a stacking rule for two-column rows). Test-send to a phone first.
- ~~**Title link cue**~~ — closed by design (Kate, 2026-09-03): titles stay black, bold, no underline, no mark, no color. Underlines (three tints), colored titles, weight change, hover underline and trailing marks were all mocked in the full issue and rejected. The rule instead: every title carries a link.
- ~~**Group spacing**~~ — applied: item dividers 12px each side (25px with the rule), later group labels 32px below the last item.
- ~~**Line length**~~ — applied: item cells and the intro end 80px from the right edge (≈94 characters per line, 76 beside a stamp). Going lower would need a larger body size.
- **Digest bullets** as table cells, not lists (deliberate for Outlook). **Brand images** on i.ibb.co (move to the desk's own hosting). *Masthead moved 2026-09-08: new banner, 2080 x 280, at builder/images/newsletter-masthead.png. The footer lockup is still on i.ibb.co.*

## Builder and desk scope: not applied (out of scope for the template work)

- Applied in the template only: `www.` and bare-domain URLs are linked as `https://…` (`normalizeHref`, item and prose links), so a scheme-less URL no longer drops its link silently.
- Flag dropped links and block export without a date in the builder's export step.
- "View in browser" link once the archive step (`/builder/newsletters/<date>.html`) runs before the send.
- A date/time format rule for contributors (weekday, time zone).

Desktop Outlook (masthead width) and a phone (scale) could not be rendered here.
